title: Gyo
label: Quick read (from summaries)
premise: On vacation in Okinawa, Tadashi and his girlfriend Kaori are attacked by a rotting fish walking on mechanical spider legs. Sea creatures and then infected people are carried ashore by machines that run on a putrid gas, which traces back to a wartime weapon developed by Tadashi's grandfather. Viz publishes a deluxe edition with two bonus stories, including The Enigma of Amigara Fault; rating to verify.
life_message: It shows the horror of weapons and human folly coming back to haunt the living, with a faint hope at the end.
